title: Frukt Cyder Mango & Raspberry 100ml E-liquid
description: This sweet summertime vape from the Frukt Cider collection features a luscious profile of creamy tropical mango blended with tangy raspberries and softly sparkling cider. Just as refreshing as a big gulp of ice-cold cider on a scorching summer day, Mango & Raspberry is the ideal high VG e-juice to get yourself in the mood for warmer weather, hours lost in pub gardens and soaking up the sun with your sub ohm setup in hand.
